headline: H-ONE Battles Cyberattack as Production Grinds to a Halt
body: Automotive supplier H-ONE Co., Ltd. has suffered a ransomware attack crippling its manufacturing and logistics networks. As a result, key production facilities have been forced to shut down temporarily. The company has called in external cybersecurity teams to tackle the breach but has not provided an exact timeline on when operations might resume. The incident underscores significant vulnerabilities in the industry's supply chain infrastructure.
